summary: Full regression for Iteration-3 Delhivery API fixes (warehouse register/order create/pickup schedule/label PDF/bulk ZIP/pincode). All 25 backend tests pass including 7 new tests targeting the specific fixes; frontend Settings, SchedulePickup and BulkUpload flows verified live against Delhivery production API with STAYFREE warehouse.

issues: Pickup Date input uses the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component used elsewhere in shadcn-based UIs. Cosmetic only; functionality works.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <input type=date> on SchedulePickup with shadcn Calendar/Popover for design consistency.
(Optional) Surface 'already exists' more clearly in the warehouse register API response (currently returns success=true with a message; UI handles correctly via toast).
critical_code_review_comments: create_delhivery_shipment() correctly sends pickup_location with only {name} - matches Delhivery client warehouse lookup contract; root cause of 'ClientWarehouse matching query does not exist' was sending extra fields - now fixed.
schedule_delhivery_pickup() now POSTs to https://track.delhivery.com/fm/request/new/ (no /api prefix) with JSON body - aligned with Delhivery docs; 404 routing bug resolved.
get_shipment_label() fetches the actual PDF from Delhivery's pdf_download_link (S3) and streams it back as application/pdf with a proper %PDF header - verified end-to-end on live waybill.
bulk_download_labels() returns a valid ZIP containing per-waybill PDFs - verified by parsing the ZIP and reading PDF magic bytes.
Warehouse register handles XML and the 'already exists' case gracefully with success=true.
server.py is now ~900 lines - consider splitting into modules (routes/, services/delhivery.py, models.py) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
All endpoints return JSON without MongoDB _id leakage; URLs and credentials come from env vars (no hardcoding).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Settings save + Register Warehouse, SchedulePickup form, BulkUpload page loads with template/upload UI, Shipments list renders Manifested rows)

test_credentials: Delhivery API key already in backend/.env (e77ef181...). Live API used; STAYFREE warehouse on client GEETA69 FRANCHISE.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 live shipment via /api/orders (TEST_IT3_<timestamp>) using STAYFREE/Indore -> Mumbai. Real waybill issued by Delhivery (numeric, >=10 digits) and persisted in MongoDB; status='Manifested'.
verified_endpoints: GET /api/shipments/{id} -> persisted with waybill + STAYFREE pickup
verified_frontend_flows: Settings: form fill -> Save Settings (success toast) -> Register Warehouse with Delhivery (info toast: 'Warehouse STAYFREE is already registered ... ready to use')
SchedulePickup: route /pickup loads, pickup_location auto-filled from settings (STAYFREE), pickup_time field absent (per spec), form submits to /api/pickups, form resets indicating success
BulkUpload: route /bulk-upload loads with 'Download Template', file dropzone, 'Upload & Create Shipments', and 'Export All Shipments' buttons (data-testid='download-template-btn' present)
Shipments list renders rows incl. Manifested status
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use sender email with valid TLD (e.g. example.com) NOT '.test' - Pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test'. Test data prefix TEST_IT3_. The STAYFREE warehouse on Delhivery client GEETA69 FRANCHISE is confirmed working. /api/orders requires pickup_location to match a registered warehouse name exactly; backend now sends only {name} to Delhivery for pickup_location (fix from this iteration). SchedulePickup route is /pickup (singular), BulkUpload is /bulk-upload.
